title: The Role of SanDisk (SNDK) in Advancing AI Memory Solutions

content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Mon, August 10, 2026 at 9:42 AM EDT 3 min read

Sands Capital, an investment management company, released its "Sands Capital Technology Innovators Fund" Q2 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. In the quarter, global equities rebounded sharply, with the MSCI ACWI posting its strongest quarterly gain since 2020, supported by broad market strength, easing geopolitical tensions, and continued enthusiasm for AI infrastructure. Information technology led the advance, with semiconductor and hardware companies accounting for most of the index's rise. The fund returned 26.9% (net) in the second quarter of 2026. The portfolio benefited from strong gains across memory, software infrastructure, cybersecurity, and other AI-related holdings, although its concentrated exposure to mega-cap chip designers and manufacturers weighed on relative performance as leadership broadened into CPUs, networking, and memory. Vertical software, internet, and financial holdings were modest detractors amid macro concerns and uncertainty over AI disruption. The fund remains focused on critical AI bottlenecks, including compute, memory, manufacturing, networking, and power, while retaining selected businesses that may use AI to strengthen their competitive positions. You can check the fund's top five holdings to learn more about its leading investment ideas for the year.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Sands Capital Technology Innovators Fund highlighted Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) as a newly added position. Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the United States and internationally. On August 7, 2026, Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) closed at $1,212.21 per share. The one-month return of Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) was -27.58%, and its shares gained 2,695.04% over the past 52 weeks. Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) has a market capitalization of $176.98 billion.

Sands Capital Technology Innovators Fund stated the following regarding Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) is a U.S.-based provider of flash memory and storage technologies. As agentic AI systems handle more complex tasks with less human direction, they need to access, process, and retain larger amounts of context, subscription pricing power. However, we believe AIenabled short-form video could become an increasingly strong competitor for consumer engagement over time, creating greater uncertainty around Netflix's terminal value."

投资管理公司金沙资本发布了“金沙资本科技创新基金”2026年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 本季度，全球股市大幅反弹，MSCI ACWI 录得 2020 年以来最强劲的季度涨幅，这得益于广泛的市场走强、地缘政治紧张局势的缓解以及对人工智能基础设施持续热情的支持。 信息技术领涨，半导体和硬件公司占该指数涨幅的大部分。 该基金 2026 年第二季度的净回报率为 26.9%。 该投资组合受益于内存、软件基础设施、网络安全和其他人工智能相关资产的强劲增长，尽管随着领先地位扩大到 CPU、网络和内存，其对大型芯片设计商和制造商的集中投资影响了相对表现。 由于宏观担忧和人工智能颠覆的不确定性，垂直软件、互联网和金融控股是温和的负面​​因素。 该基金仍然专注于关键的人工智能瓶颈，包括计算、内存、制造、网络和电力，同时保留可能使用人工智能来加强其竞争地位的选定企业。 您可以查看该基金的前五名持股，以了解更多有关其年度主要投资理念的信息。

在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中，金沙资本技术创新基金强调 Sandisk Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）是新增加的头寸。 Sandisk Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）在美国和国际上开发、制造和销售使用 NAND 闪存技术的数据存储设备和解决方案。 2026 年 8 月 7 日，Sandisk Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）收盘价为每股 1,212.21 美元。 Sandisk公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）的一个月回报率为-27.58%，其股价在过去52周内上涨了2,695.04%。 Sandisk 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）的市值为 1769.8 亿美元。

金沙资本科技创新基金在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 Sandisk Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）做出了以下声明：

“闪迪公司（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）是一家美国闪存和存储技术提供商。 随着代理人工智能系统在更少的人工指导下处理更复杂的任务，它们需要访问、处理和保留更大量的上下文和订阅定价能力。 然而，我们相信，随着时间的推移，人工智能短视频可能会成为消费者参与度方面日益强大的竞争对手，从而给 Netflix 的最终价值带来更大的不确定性。”
